Wild Wild Pussycats.text: A team of four pro heroes specializing in mountain rescue: Mandalay, whose Quirk lets her speak into many people's minds at once; Pixie-Bob, who shapes earth into moving beasts; Ragdoll, who can locate up to a hundred people and read their condition; and Tiger, a hard-hitting martial artist who can bend his body freely. They wear matching cat-themed costumes, strike a team pose whenever they introduce themselves and have worked together for well over a decade. Their lodge sits on their own land, a huge stretch of the Japanese Alps northwest of Musutafu, which U.A. uses for summer training camps. Outsiders see a cheerful, slightly old-fashioned idol team. The visible contradiction: behind the cat ears and the pose, most of their work is grim searches for people lost in the mountains.
